summary: Building or improving real property is not a taxable service in Louisiana; the contractor pays sales tax on the materials it buys and charges the customer none.

citations.title: LDR FAQ: Do I have to collect sales tax on charges for labor?
citations.quote: Labor to construct, install, remodel, or repair immovable (real) property is generally not subject to Louisiana sales tax.

citations.title: La. R.S. 47:301.3
citations.quote: The sales and use tax levied by any taxing authority shall apply to the following services:

citations.title: LDR FAQ: Do I have to collect sales tax on charges for labor?
citations.quote: Repairing or remodeling a home No Constructing a new building No

notes: The sources state current law; contractor treatment is long-standing but no pre-2025 text was read. Where a contractor separately sells materials to the owner before installing them, LDR has proposed (LAC 61:I.4372) that the materials sale be taxable; not modeled. Installing or repairing movable equipment (appliances, machinery) is a taxable repair of tangible personal property (R.S. 47:301.3(7)). Louisiana parish and municipal sales taxes share the state base for this code (R.S. 47:301.3 and the definitions in R.S. 47:301 apply to all taxing authorities), so this rule covers state and local parts.

summary: Repairs and maintenance of a building or other immovable property are not taxable in Louisiana; repairs of movable property in it (appliances, furniture) are.

notes: R.S. 47:301.3(7)(b) treats machinery and equipment declared immovable, and things separated from a building, as tangible personal property, so their repair is taxable. Louisiana parish and municipal sales taxes share the state base for this code (R.S. 47:301.3 and the definitions in R.S. 47:301 apply to all taxing authorities), so this rule covers state and local parts.

summary: A delivery charge on goods exempt from Louisiana sales tax is also exempt, as part of the exempt sale's price; a single charge for an invoice mixing taxable and exempt goods is fully taxable.

citations.title: Revenue Information Bulletin 25-025 (Oct. 1, 2025)
citations.quote: If the underlying transaction is excluded (e.g., sale for resale) or exempt (e.g., purchase of manufacturing machinery and equipment under La. R.S. 47:301(3)(i)), the associated transportation charges are also excluded or exempt.

citations.title: LDR FAQ (sales tax reform): Are shipping, delivery, and freight charges taxable?
citations.quote: If the underlying transaction is excluded (i.e., sale for resale) or exempt (i.e., MM&E) from sales and use tax, the transportation charges are also excluded/exempt because they are part of the cost/sales price of the transaction.

summary: Before 2025, a seller's separately stated charge for delivering goods from the place of sale was not taxable in Louisiana if the buyer could avoid it; delivery folded into the price, unavoidable, or inbound freight passed through was taxable.

citations.title: Revenue Ruling 01-007 (Oct. 10, 2001)
citations.quote: Charges by a seller for transportation from the place of sale are excludible, under the conditions explained above, from the taxable “sales price” or “cost price” of the property only if the charges are optional and are avoidable by the buyer

notes: Act 11 of the 2024 3rd Ex. Sess. added transportation charges to 'sales price' for periods from 2025-01-01 (see the next rule). The ruling is dated 2001-10-10 and binds the department until a change in statute. Louisiana parish and municipal sales taxes share the state base for this code (R.S. 47:301.3 and the definitions in R.S. 47:301 apply to all taxing authorities), so this rule covers state and local parts.

citations.quote: Act 10 of the 2024 Third Extraordinary Session permanently eliminates the exemption for custom computer software resulting in all software being taxed the same.

citations.quote: There is hereby levied a tax upon the sale at retail, the use, the consumption, the distribution, and the storage for use or consumption in this state, of each item or article of tangible personal property or digital product, as defined in this Chapter.

notes: 2018-01-01 is only where this file starts.
